# Home Lab Coding Instructions

This file is the shared instruction baseline for coding agents in this repository.

## Workflow Rules

1. Always analyze relevant code, domains, and Documentation files before planning.
2. For non-trivial work, provide a plan summary and get approval before implementation.
3. If requirements or architecture intent are unclear, ask before proceeding.
4. Keep changes focused and aligned to existing domain boundaries.

## Documentation Maintenance Rule

When work introduces new logic/rules/standards or changes existing logic/rules/standards, update the relevant `docs/*.md` files in the same change set or add new documentation files as needed.
